The strongest of the [[Droid light plating type 1|light-grade]] plating, '''light plating type 3''' was the best protection most owners considered purchasing for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] not intended for active combat.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
